resources.string: Add Google Pixel features in Google Photos on any device.
Make sure to spoof only in Google Photos.
The module is by default only activated for Google Photos. If you want to use it in other apps, then keep this toggle OFF.
Pass false to hooked method for higher feature levels present in ROM if user selects a lower Pixel feature level. (Recommended)

Could not connect to the Xposed framework service.
 
 Make sure the module is enabled in LSPosed and that your framework supports the Modern Xposed API (101 or higher).
 
 The framework pushes its service while this app's process is starting, so after enabling the module you must fully close this app (Force stop) and open it again - or simply reboot.

Android 17 compatibility release.
 
 - Native ACC_FINAL helper restores Build.MODEL/BRAND/... spoofing on Android 17.
 - Every Build prop write is read back and verified; failures are logged.
 - Fixed forward-reference bug in the follow-device Android version option.
 - Import/export, force-stop and spinner edge cases fixed.
 - After enabling/updating the module, force stop Google Photos once.
Please force stop Google Photos to take effect.
Save or share your settings of this module with others.\n \"Save\" will prompt to select a location to export the settings as a JSON file.
This will open a system window to select the configuration file.
Read error! Make sure to select a proper file!
More debug information in LSPosed logs and Android logcat.\n To share logs, open LSPosed -> Logs -> top Save icon. Then share the created file.

This is an advanced, risky option and is off by default.\n Versions whose SDK is lower than the real device SDK are skipped automatically to avoid legacy-code startup crashes.\n Do not set an Android version greater than your current version.
